scope: R3.3 phase-0 error-range decision; no R3.4 success threshold or held-out validation
external_rule: Choose and justify a range of bit-error probabilities; the external specifies neither this range nor the anchor-seed mapping
range_reason: Three decades cover rare multi-error events through frequent failures of the one-error-correcting short block; p=0.001 retains the reference anchor. Extra stress points expose loss of BER advantage and the zero-capacity limit without determining the personal probability.
parameter_distribution_call: Generator(PCG64(SeedSequence(2470964, spawn_key=(0,1), pool_size=4))).random() once; deterministic reruns replay it
mapping_reason: Equal weight to equal logarithmic decades over the positive primary range; project convention, not a reference formula, prescribed external mapping or physical prior
gaussian_source: Exact replay of R3.1 personal SNR bank (1,3,0,5,g), frozen filter and quantiser

new_bsc_conditions.role: stress: above capacity and near loss of BER advantage
personal point bound exactly once after mapping freeze

reuse_rule: Read R3.2 measurements and manifests at existing IDs; do not count replayed or imported records as new independent observations. Only IDs 8..11 add new masks.
budget: 40 independent BSC masks per positive p/layout; 17,920,000 payload bits and 4,480,000 Hamming blocks per p. At the lowest p about 0.94 out-of-radius blocks are expected, so no precise empirical rare-event BER claim is made.
uncertainty: Pointwise exact 95% Clopper-Pearson intervals for iid channel flips and disjoint-codeword failures; no binomial interval over correlated decoded Hamming bits. These intervals are not simultaneous guarantees.
scope_of_probability: Per transmitted bit; same p does not mean equal transmitted bits, equal realised error counts, equal energy or equal throughput
no_validation_streams: Do not consume study-3 phase-1 or study-4 streams; R3.4 freezes its own quality threshold, statistical success rule and independent-record budget
